title: Beam-Tree
summary: BE'AM-TREE, noun A species of wild service. The Crataegus Aria. BEAM, noun A ray of light, emitted from the sun, or other luminous body. BEAM, verb transitive To send forth; to emit. BEAM, verb intran

inlines.v: BE'AM-TREE, noun A species of wild service. The Crataegus Aria. BEAM, noun A ray of light, emitted from the sun, or other luminous body. BEAM, verb transitive To send forth; to emit. BEAM, verb intransitive To emit rays of light, or beams; to shine. He beam'd, the day star of the rising age.
